items.title: Philstar: 'Demna gets personal at Gucci for Milan Fashion Week' (AFP wire)
items.summary: Filipino daily runs AFP's report on Demna's SS27 'Store Show' at Milan Fashion Week, describing hooded rebellious menswear and 1980s-Milanese-inspired womenswear with midriff cutouts. Article factually notes Gucci sales have disappointed since Alessandro Michele's exit and continued declining in Q2 2026, though at a slower rate than Q1 per Kering's July statement. Tone is neutral-to-descriptive; qualifies as activation coverage (largely press-kit derived show description) rather than independent critical judgment.

items.title: WWD: Bernstein analyst Luca Solca calls Demna's Gucci debut 'more good than bad'
items.summary: WWD reports Bernstein luxury analyst Luca Solca's independent assessment of Demna's SS27 show as a mixed-but-net-positive reaction, 'clearly not a home run, but still an improvement' versus predecessor Sabato De Sarno's lower-scoring 2023 debut. This is independent third-party analyst judgment (not brand-staged content), relevant to SEA retail buyers gauging merchandise direction and investor sentiment ahead of regional allocation decisions.

items.title: Tatler Asia: 'Gucci is getting a new look with Demna' — SS27 review for regional readers
items.summary: Tatler Asia's SEA-facing lifestyle desk covers Demna's SS27 collection, framing it as Gucci recapturing 'sprezzatura' (studied nonchalance) after a subdued Michele-to-De Sarno transition. Largely descriptive with light editorial praise; falls under activation-coverage discount since verdict is mild and outlet-typical fashion-week coverage rather than sharp independent critique.

items.title: Thai Gucci ambassador PP Krit's fan account posts Milan departure for SS27 show
items.summary: Official fan/management account for Thai actor PP Krit, a newly named Gucci ambassador, posts his departure look en route to the SS27 'Store Show' in Milan, tagged #GUCCISS27xPPKRIT and #GucciTheStoreShow. Fandom-driven ambassador coverage; per sentiment rubric this is fan-event volume subject to magnitude damping, not organic brand-affinity signal. Engagement counts not visible on fetch (platform blocked access); recorded as null rather than estimated.

items.title: Weibo discussion thread: 'BKPP at Milan Fashion Week sparks buzz, Gucci ambassador status recognized by international fashion media, how do netizens rate it?'
items.summary: Chinese-language social discussion (cross-posted/visible to SEA fan communities following Thai stars Billkin and PP Krit) debates the pair's simultaneous Gucci ambassador debut in Milan, generally framing it as a status win for the two Thai actors' international profile. Fan-driven engagement; treated per fandom trap in sentiment rubric (damped magnitude, not counted as organic brand-quality sentiment). No visible like/repost counts on the page as fetched.

items.title: Lowyat.net forum thread on Gucci's KLCC Malaysia store closure — still active discussion, 5,300+ views
items.summary: Malaysian tech/lifestyle forum thread (originally posted June 22, 2026) discussing Gucci's exit from Suria KLCC, reportedly over the mall enforcing sales-KPI eviction after six months of missed targets, with Gucci relocating to TRX/Pavilion. Majority commenter sentiment is negative-to-dismissive toward the brand ('cringe brand', mall called 'dead'), with one sympathetic note toward displaced sales staff. NOTE: thread origin is outside the 14-day freshness window; included only because it remains an active, recirculating community discussion referenced in fresher September 2026 social posts (see item 07) about the same closure — flagged as borderline-stale and should not anchor today's index without corroborating fresh coverage.

items.title: Threads post (Malay-language): 'Kenapa Gucci KLCC tutup' (Why did Gucci KLCC close)
items.summary: Recent Malay-language Threads post asking why Gucci's KLCC store closed, indicating the closure is still circulating as fresh organic discussion among Malaysian consumers months after the actual event, discussed alongside Dior's parallel exit and rumored replacement tenants (including budget retailer speculation). Organic consumer curiosity mixed with mild brand-image skepticism about luxury retail's retreat from a formerly premier mall.

items.title: MEGA (PH) previews Gucci SS27 'The Store Show' livestream timing for Filipino audience
items.summary: Philippine lifestyle title MEGA gives Filipino readers the local broadcast time for Gucci's SS27 livestream, noting it follows Demna's February debut and the Cruise 2027 Times Square event. Purely access/promotional framing with zero independent evaluative content; scored 0 under activation-coverage rule (descriptive write-up, no verdict).

items.title: BoF: 'Demna's Gucci Back Under the Microscope at Milan Fashion Week'
items.summary: BoF's trade briefing frames Demna's SS27 show as a make-or-break credibility test after a mixed debut season, citing continued Gucci sales softness and investor impatience with the pace of turnaround under CEO Luca de Meo. Independent trade-press judgment relevant to SEA wholesale/retail partners assessing brand momentum; carries appropriately critical framing rather than pure activation description.

items.title: TheFashionSpot forum thread on Gucci SS27 Milan show splits between praise and 'worst show' criticism
items.summary: Long-running fashion-community forum thread reacting live to Gucci's SS27 collection shows a genuine split: some posters call it 'a step in the right direction' with 'great clothes,' while others call the womenswear 'ABYSMAL,' bags and shoes 'trash,' and one calls it 'easily the worst show I have seen in Milan.' This is organic enthusiast community sentiment (not brand-staged), providing a real critical counterweight to editorial activation coverage; not SEA-origin specifically but read and cited by SEA-based fashion forum participants tracking Milan collections.
